story.zh: 后主降魏，汉祚终结。蜀地局势看似尘埃落定，然蜀汉旧部似乎仍存复汉之心。魏廷内部更是功臣相忌、裂隙暗藏……
story.en: The Latter Ruler surrendered to Wei, bringing the Han dynasty to its end. Though the dust seems to have settled over Shu, remnants of Shu-Han still harbor hopes of restoration. Within the Wei court, meritorious ministers eye one another with jealousy, and hidden rifts deepen...

trigger.zh: 刘禅、姜维、钟会、邓艾存活且身属正确势力，成都、洛阳属曹奂，剧情【汉祚终倾】已完成
trigger.en: Liu Shan, Jiang Wei, Zhong Hui, and Deng Ai are alive and belong to their correct Factions, Chengdu and Luoyang belong to Cao Huan, plot event 【Fall of the Han Dynasty】 has been completed

participate.zh: 【身属曹奂势力且不为曹奂、司马昭】
participate.en: 【Belong to Cao Huan's Faction and not playing as Cao Huan or Sima Zhao】

defy.zh: 【<前刘禅势力>避免钟会、姜维死亡并收邓艾为家将】【<曹奂势力>避免钟会死亡并帮助钟会在成都自立并收邓艾为家将（不为钟会）或避免邓艾死亡并帮助邓艾在成都自立】
defy.en: 【<Former Liu Shan Faction> Prevent the deaths of Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei, and recruit Deng Ai as a Retainer】【<Cao Huan Faction> Prevent the death of Zhong Hui, help Zhong Hui declare independence in Chengdu, and recruit Deng Ai as a Retainer (not playing as Zhong Hui), or prevent the death of Deng Ai and help Deng Ai declare independence in Chengdu】

force.zh: 曹奂身为君主并占领城市<成都>
force.en: Cao Huan is Ruler and occupies City <Chengdu>

force.zh: 刘禅、姜维、蒋显、董厥、廖化、钟会、邓艾、师纂、牵弘、王颀、司马昭、卫瓘、贾充、邵悌、邓忠、郭宁、胡烈、丘建、田续、刘璿、关彝、霍弋、黄皓、郤正回归曹奂势力
force.en: Liu Shan, Jiang Wei, Jiang Xian, Dong Jue, Liao Hua, Zhong Hui, Deng Ai, Shi Zuan, Qian Hong, Wang Qi, Sima Zhao, Wei Guan, Jia Chong, Shao Ti, Deng Zhong, Guo Ning, Hu Lie, Qiu Jian, Tian Xu, Liu Xuan, Guan Yi, Huo Yi, Huang Hao, and Que Zheng return to Cao Huan's Faction
